record.context_brief: Weak continuous separating functions in LOTS
record.original_question: Suppose X is a LOTS with a sigma-closed-discrete dense set and there is a continuous function Psi from (X squared minus the diagonal) times X to R such that, whenever x and y are distinct points of X, Psi(x,y)(x) is not equal to Psi(x,y)(y). Since this is weaker than the existence of a continuous separating family, must X be metrizable?

evidence.quote: Question 21 (Gruenhage and Zenor). Suppose X is a LOTS with a σ-closed-discrete dense set and a continuous function Ψ: (X2 \ ∆) × X → R such that if x 6= y are points of X, then Ψ(x, y)(x) 6= Ψ(x, y)(y). (Note that this is weaker than the existence of a continuous separating family.) Must X be metrizable?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let X be a linearly ordered topological space (LOTS); that is, X carries the open-interval topology induced by a linear order on X. Assume that X has a dense subset which is a countable union of closed discrete subspaces (a σ-closed-discrete dense set). Suppose further that there exists a continuous function
   Ψ : (X × X ∖ Δ) × X → ℝ,
where Δ = {(x,x) : x ∈ X}, such that for every pair of distinct points x, y ∈ X one has Ψ(x,y)(x) ≠ Ψ(x,y)(y) (writing Ψ(x,y)(z) for Ψ((x,y),z)). (This hypothesis is strictly weaker than the existence of a continuous separating family on X.)

Must X be metrizable?
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches on this specific Gruenhage–Zenor question about weak continuous separating functions on a LOTS with a σ-closed-discrete dense set did not surface a definitive resolution. Related results characterize metrizability in (compact) LOTS via σ-isolated networks, Gruenhage property, fragmentability, etc., but no source confirms a solution to this particular weakened-separating-family question.

status_evidence.snippet: Survey of metrization and structural results in GO-spaces and LOTS, including σ-discrete bases and related dense-set conditions.
status_evidence.claim: Surveys close to the topic do not record a resolution of this specific Gruenhage–Zenor question.

status_evidence.title: The Gruenhage property, property *, fragmentability, and σ-isolated networks in generalized ordered spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Equivalences between metrizability and various structural properties in compact LOTS.
status_evidence.claim: Discusses metrizability criteria in LOTS but does not address the weak-Ψ separating-function question.
